entries.what_changed: A major fraction of computing-assisted benefit appears in production median, repeatability, maintenance burden, mission aborts and handling rather than top speed alone.
combat_meaning: Raises ready aircraft and reduces abort/accident leakage; can compound with later search/attack stages.

entries.what_changed: Position, time, wind, fuel, search-sector and return-position processing becomes more standardized; contact reports are more structured.
combat_meaning: Reduces navigation/reporting leakage and makes multi-layer search/recontact more viable.

entries.valid_from: prewar maturation; exact equipment-specific implementation varies
entries.what_changed: Optical calculation, glass characterization, grinding/assembly and calibration reduce systematic optical error and lot variance.

magnitude.range: optical-system angular error may shrink ~20% to 40%; final combat hit improvement is smaller/role-specific

combat_meaning: Improves sight/bombsight/camera/observation consistency; does not map one-for-one into combat hit rate.

entries.valid_from: 1941-12 opening; detailed HARD audit can revise numbers but scenario selection is fixed
entries.what_changed: Opening carrier fighter is the Zuisei-powered Zero line, not historical Sakae baseline.

range.comparative_note: F4F remains dangerous/equal-class because of protection, firepower, radio and mutual-support tactics

combat_meaning: Japanese carrier fighter advantage must be represented by range/low-speed maneuver/availability and not merely a speed bonus.

entries.valid_from: first-line standard by 1940; 1941 late standard at opening
entries.what_changed: Carrier torpedo bomber uses Zuisei 15 commonality and a 1941-late protection/fire-safety package.

range.protection: fuel shutoff/firewall/extinguisher/line separation/local fire protection/small back armor

combat_meaning: Faster/more repeatable and better protected than a simple historical-airframe baseline; maintenance commonality with Zero matters aboard carriers.

entries.valid_from: carrier conversion complete by 1940; 1941-late standard at opening
entries.what_changed: D3A late-1941 standard has improved dive-envelope repeatability, production consistency and slightly higher performance.
combat_meaning: More uniform dive geometry reduces unsafe/failed attack cases as well as dispersion.

entries.what_changed: Floatplane/seaplane force is larger and includes a small A6M2-N-equivalent water-fighter capability; local zero-to-some-air-cover effects matter more than national totals.
combat_meaning: Can close temporary aviation gaps and strengthen small-base search/observation without substituting for modern land/carrier fighters.

entries.valid_from: aircraft/weapon/training maturity dependent; opening carrier types have prewar standardization but magnitude remains audit-band
entries.what_changed: Technical dispersion, calibration and reproducibility improve for dive bombing vs moving ships under equivalent combat conditions.

magnitude.note: relative, not percentage points; aviation source labels table as pre-additional-audit center estimate

combat_meaning: Raises same-opportunity attack effectiveness.
For moving-ship dive bombing/aerial torpedo attack, may reduce aircraft required per target and free aircraft for second target/reserve/search/CAP.

entries.valid_from: aircraft/weapon/training maturity dependent; opening carrier types have prewar standardization but magnitude remains audit-band
entries.what_changed: Technical dispersion, calibration and reproducibility improve for fighter fixed guns vs fighters under equivalent combat conditions.

magnitude.note: relative, not percentage points; aviation source labels table as pre-additional-audit center estimate

combat_meaning: Raises same-opportunity attack effectiveness without removing human/visibility/enemy-motion limits.

entries.valid_from: aircraft/weapon/training maturity dependent; opening carrier types have prewar standardization but magnitude remains audit-band
entries.what_changed: Technical dispersion, calibration and reproducibility improve for aerial torpedo attack under equivalent combat conditions.

magnitude.note: relative, not percentage points; aviation source labels table as pre-additional-audit center estimate

combat_meaning: Raises same-opportunity attack effectiveness.
For moving-ship dive bombing/aerial torpedo attack, may reduce aircraft required per target and free aircraft for second target/reserve/search/CAP.

entries.what_changed: Opening Japanese combat-usable carrier aviation is larger than just the six main carriers and has role-differentiated light/converted decks.
combat_meaning: The main gain is extra supported operational fronts and flexibility; Taiyo combat use trades against replacement-aircraft ferry capacity.
do_not_simplify_as: all aircraft concentrated in one decisive carrier battle

entries.valid_from: opening for named converted/light carriers subject to wind/load constraints
entries.what_changed: Improved low-speed aircraft handling, load management and deck operations can move some light/converted carriers up one mission class without changing hull physics.

range: aircraft transport -> limited escort/assault support carrier
converted merchant carrier -> low-speed medium fleet carrier

combat_meaning: Adds operational fronts where air support can be provided without consuming a first-line fleet carrier.
do_not_simplify_as: hull becomes fleet carrier in all conditions

entries.what_changed: Protection/reliability is modeled as transition probabilities among healthy, localized damage, degraded function, mission kill, immobile and loss states.
combat_meaning: Small hit-probability changes may create large operational differences when they cross mission-kill or repair thresholds.

entries.what_changed: Calculated design improvements are allowed to consume safety margin only as test/sister-unit reproducibility matures.
combat_meaning: Keeps early calculation gains from becoming instant fleet-wide optimized production while allowing repeated evidence to improve standard design.

entries.what_changed: Effects at distinct causal stages may compound; effects feeding the same intermediate state are integrated there first. Thresholds and reallocation can amplify modest component changes.
combat_meaning: Avoids both unconditional percentage multiplication and the opposite error of treating all improvements as isolated increments.

entries.what_changed: Nominal hull/airframe existence is not combat power. Evaluate Hull/airframe -> Availability -> Mission set -> Mission effectiveness -> Allocation.
combat_meaning: Prevents paper OOB and headline performance from being treated as available combat force.

entries.what_changed: Optical glass characterization and production control reduce lot-to-lot refractive/dispersion variance and assembly error.
combat_meaning: Improves consistency of rangefinding/night observation/photo/periscope systems; combat effectiveness still depends on crew/weather/I-O.

entries.what_changed: Radar provides meaningful rough detection/early warning but remains a human-mediated input into plotting, optical confirmation and fire control.

magnitude.range: applicable practical detection may improve ~5-15%; primary value is non-optical warning input, not automatic accuracy

combat_meaning: Can buy warning minutes and recover contact in poor visibility; does not automatically identify, solve motion, direct CAP or guarantee gunfire.

entries.what_changed: Radar range, optical bearing, track prediction, multiple-target management and fighter/fire-control direction can approach a tactical closed loop.
entries.warning: Relevant capability exists in the index but is not yet mature for this event date; do not back-port it.

entries.valid_from: improving at opening; more mature through 1942 and after carrier-battle lessons
entries.what_changed: Search evolves from single-pass sector search toward broad search, suspicious-contact revisit, fast confirmation, tracking and later position update.
combat_meaning: Raises chance that ambiguous sightings become timely actionable tracks instead of expiring observations.

entries.what_changed: Japanese high-grade operational cryptosystems plus key/traffic discipline prevent the US from normally reconstructing location, exact schedule and force composition from high-grade ciphertext with short-strategic timeliness/precision.

magnitude.range: high-grade content near-unavailable for short-strategic exploitation; not mathematical/permanent impossibility

combat_meaning: Historical JN-25-like content advantages must not be silently reinserted into US pre-battle knowledge.

entries.what_changed: Unreadable high-grade content does not remove low-grade codes, plaintext, peripheral traffic, traffic volume, callsigns/frequencies, DF, air/sub reconnaissance, geography and logistics inference.
combat_meaning: Enemy can form candidate-operation probabilities and rough force/activity estimates but with worse precision/freshness.

entries.what_changed: Information acquisition, analyst confidence, headquarters acceptance, decision and field execution are separate states.
combat_meaning: A cryptanalytic or reconnaissance warning changes history only if it remains timely and is believed/acted on.
